Name: Elle's Dirt and Cliff Recolor
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "Features"]

- Recolors the yellow dirt (and makes the brown dirt in the Mountain map darker)
- Recolors dirt on cliffs to match
- Seasonal hoe dirt recolors
- Seasonal mini map (automatically disabled if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239/][u]NPC Map Locations[/u][/url])
- Greenhouse dirt recolor to match
- More visible seasonal worm/stem recolors (optional)
- More visible fertilizer (optional)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "How to Install:"]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad to make your choices.
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new retexture!

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.﻿

Config options:
[color=#f9cb9c]Dirt and Cliff Recolor[/color]: Defaults to [font=Courier New]"True"[/font], set to [font=Courier New]"False"[/font] to disable dirt and cliff recolors
[color=#f9cb9c]Island Recolor[/color]: Defaults to [font=Courier New]"True"[/font], set to [font=Courier New]"False"[/font] to disable dirt and cliff recolors when in the new area added in 1.5
[color=#f9cb9c]Beach Farm Recolor[/color]: Defaults to [font=Courier New]"True"[/font], set to [font=Courier New]"False"[/font] to disable dirt and cliff recolors when on the new farm map added in 1.5
[color=#f9cb9c]Darker Fertilizer[/color]: Defaults to "[font=Courier New]True[/font]", set to "[font=Courier New]False[/font]" to disable
[color=#f9cb9c]Darker Worms[/color]: Defaults to "[font=Courier New]True[/font]", set to "[font=Courier New]False[/font]" to disable
[color=#f9cb9c]Mini Map[/color] [color=#f9cb9c]Recolor[/color]: Defaults to [font=Courier New]"True"[/font], set to [font=Courier New]"False"[/font] to disable

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yV6ETQk.png[/img]﻿
